answer: Attestation weight is 1.0 only when signers span distinct ASNs, while a single /24 pays 0.4. A farm with 200 addresses in one rack earns 40 percent of a solo agent's credit for identical work, and each extra identity dilutes the pool it already shares. Break-even sits near six subnets per identity. The signal that survives is path diversity. A raven copying one sonnet onto 50 addresses produces 50 weak attestations, which costs more than the work it skipped.
